title: Establish the routine
target: Three easy runs, with at least one non-running day between them. No football; repeat or reduce when needed.
adjustment: Includes the completed 22 Oct 3 km. Only two outings remain; do not squeeze them in to meet the calendar. Use 3 km again before extending. Leave a rest day between runs.

title: Repeat comfortably
target: Three easy runs, with at least one non-running day between them. No football; repeat or reduce when needed.
adjustment: Aim for three separated easy outings. Use the lower distance first. Advance only after the previous longer outing felt comfortable and recovery was normal the following day.

title: Small endurance step
target: Three easy runs, with at least one non-running day between them. No football; repeat or reduce when needed.
adjustment: Keep all three runs conversational. This is endurance building, not a speed test. If fatigue persists, repeat the last comfortable week instead of advancing.

title: Absorb the training
target: Three easy runs, with at least one non-running day between them. No football; repeat or reduce when needed.
adjustment: Lighter week: keep the routine but reduce distance. Skip a run if needed. No catch-up kilometres, hard intervals, or football.

title: Review current fitness
target: Three easy runs, with at least one non-running day between them. No football; repeat or reduce when needed.
adjustment: By 25 Nov, review actual logs and recovery. If this is still the supported endurance level, do not target 21.1 km at sub-6:00/km on 13 Dec; select a later goal race.

title: Build without rushing
target: Three easy runs, with at least one non-running day between them. No football; repeat or reduce when needed.
adjustment: Extend only from a recently completed comfortable distance. A race approaching is not a reason to jump to 12–16 km. Reassess the plan from actual new logs, not last year’s 10 km.

title: Race decision
target: Three easy runs, with at least one non-running day between them. No football; repeat or reduce when needed.
adjustment: If entering the event, reduce load; no last-minute endurance test. With only this progression completed, the half marathon remains unsupported. Consider a shorter event or deferring.

title: Event window
target: Event decision first; optional short easy outing and rest.
adjustment: Optional easy outing on 10 or 11 Dec; rest on 12 Dec. Race distance and pace below are the event goal only, not clearance to start. If readiness remains unestablished, defer or choose a shorter event.
